description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

 We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

 From air-launched effects and open interceptor systems like White Spike to advanced autonomy and mission-critical software, our work directly shapes multi-domain operations for demanding government customers. We're scaling rapidly (recently acquired by KONGSBERG and growing fast), and we're seeking elite software engineering talent   to   architect   and   deliver   the   high-reliability,   safety-critical   software   that   powers   these groundbreaking systems. If you're a battle-tested senior engineer who thrives on owning complex domains, mentoring high-performing teams, driving technical excellence in regulated aerospace/defense environments, and solving problems where failure is not an option   —   this   is   your   opportunity   to   leave   a   lasting   mark   on   next-generation   flight   and   strike  capabilities.   

 We're looking for a principal-level C#/.NET software engineer (with strong embedded or real-time systems depth) ready to lead the design and evolution of complex, high-assurance software for autonomous UAS platforms in the aerospace and defense sector.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 
 Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and verification of embedded and application-level software for high-reliability, safety-critical UAS systems — from flight controls and mission autonomy to ground station integration and real-time data processing.

 Own end-to-end technical ownership of major software components or subsystems, driving decisions on technology stack, performance optimization, fault tolerance, and certification pathways (DO-178C familiarity a strong plus). 



 Collaborate deeply with systems, hardware, GNC, flight test, and cybersecurity teams to define requirements, resolve cross-domain challenges, and integrate software into full-system flight demonstrations.



 Champion modern development excellence: architect and evolve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions + AWS), automated testing frameworks, build systems, and deployment strategies for cloud-edge hybrid environments.



 Mentor and guide mid-level and senior engineers, conduct in-depth code/design reviews, establish best practices, and foster a culture of rigorous, high-quality engineering in a fast-paced environment.



 Contribute to strategic technical roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., real-time middleware, model-based design, AI/ML integration for autonomy), and influence   product   direction   for   long-range   strike ,   counter-UAS,   and   multi-domain  systems.
 
 

 Support qualification, certification, and airworthiness processes through rigorous verification, validation, and documentation in compliance with defense and aerospace   standards.   

 
 Qualifications: 

 
 8–15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent on complex, high-reliability or safety-critical systems (aerospace, defense, automotive, medical devices, or similar strongly preferred).   

 
 
 Deep expertise in C# (preferred) and strong proficiency in additional languages such as C/C++, Python, or Matlab/Simulink for real-time/embedded/model-based workflows.   

 
 
 Proven track record designing and delivering real-time embedded software, flight-critical applications, autonomy stacks, or mission systems for UAS, drones, robotics,   or   related   platforms.   

 
 
 Advanced hands-on mastery of Git/GitHub workflows at scale, Visual Studio, and scripting/automation (Bash, PowerShell, Python) for build/deploy/test pipelines.   

 
 
 Strong experience building and optimizing CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions required; Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar a plus) and deploying/managing software in AWS or hybrid cloud environments.   

 
 
 Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architecture across teams, and deliver under aggressive schedules in regulated industries.   

 
 
 Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills — able to distill complex technical concepts for cross-functional stakeholders and drive consensus on tough trade-offs.   

 
 
 U.S. person status required (ability to obtain and maintain security clearance preferred; existing clearance a significant advantage).   

 
  

 Compensation: 

 Level V - $162,000 - 192,000

 Level VI - $192,000 - 223,000

  

 To ensure you've read this description, please start your cover letter or the 'summary' section of your application with the phrase: [Favorite Tool] Specialist found. Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed. 
 Pay range for this role
 $162,000 — $223,000 USD 


 What's in it for you: 

 Benefits: 

 
 Competitive total compensation package 

 Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

 401k with company-match 

 3 weeks of paid time off each year

 40 hours of sick time

 12 annual company holidays

 
 Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

 
 Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

 Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

 
 If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team! 

 In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. 

 Zone 5 Technologies is a federal contractor and participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. As required by law, we will verify the identity and employment authorization of all new employees using the E-Verify system. Learn more about your rights and responsibilities under E-Verify:  https://www.e-verify.gov .
